parameters.name: AcceptLanguage
parameters.description:
The language of the response. Valid values:

- `zh-CN`: Chinese

- `en-US`: English

Default value: `en-US`.

> This parameter takes precedence over the `Lang` parameter.

parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description: A client token to ensure request idempotence. Your client must generate a unique token for each request. The token can contain only ASCII characters.
